name: Create thread
description:
## Summary

1. Investigated the broken "Create thread" action across `ChatEntry.vue`, `Chat.vue` and `store/chats.js` to find the root cause.
2. Found a dead duplicate `createNewThread` action (the live one set `parent_id` to the grandparent) plus an unguarded `createNewBoardChat` column lookup that threw a `TypeError` whenever the parent chat had no board/column, silently killing the click.
3. Rewrote `createNewThread` as an idempotent create-or-open bound to `parent_id` (chat id) and `message_id` (message doc_id), inheriting mode, board/column, files and profiles, opening the chat, and no longer auto-running the model or copying the source message.
4. Hardened `createNewBoardChat` so a missing board or column is created instead of crashing, and scoped `displayMessage`'s "latest reply" behaviour in `ChatEntry.vue` to topic/Slack chats only.
5. Result: first click creates and opens the thread, repeat clicks reopen the existing thread, and the parent bubble always renders its own content with the `N replies` badge as the navigation entry point.
